Guidance & outlook: Coming to our quarterly financial highlights on a year -on-year basis, total income for Q1 FY27 stood at INR770.5 crores, a growth of 6.6%.
EBITDA for quarter 1 FY27 stood at INR201.4 crores, a growth of 133.9%.
EBITDA margins for quarter 1 FY27 improved to 26.1%, an increase in 1,420 basis points.
Growth & demand: Profit after tax for Q1 FY27 stood at INR137.3 crores, a growth of 150.
Profit after tax margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 17.8%, a growth of 1,023 basis points.
Sales volume for Q1 FY27 stood at 38.9 KT, a dip of 26%.
Margins & costs: EBITDA for quarter 1 FY27 stood at INR223.6 crores and EBITDA margin stood at 22%.
Profit after tax for Q1 FY27 stood at INR138.3 crores and profit margin stood at 13.6%.
Like historically, when I look, we were at around 10% to 12% broad margin range.
Capex & expansion: We are expanding capacities on all sites, which is in rubber, SAN and compounding to meet the additional capacity expansion requirements.
With regards to the capex question, I believe that we are still kind of very close to doing whatever commissioning that we need to do.

But there are, of course, in a running plant where we are Styrenix Performance Materials Limited August 05, 2026 doing brownfield expansion and we are doing this kind of -- while the current plant is running, there are challenges that do arise.
Balance sheet & cash: And obviously, with expansion, we will get whatever cost -- operating cost leverages that we can get.
Post war now, I think we've got some extra bonus and extra cash flow to utilize in the business.
And that capex, along with whatever cash flow we are generating, we try to ensure that all our shareholders are also fairly treated accordingly.
Risks & challenges: The quarter gone by was marked by an operating environment characterized by heightened uncertainties driven by evolving global macroeconomic conditions, geopolitical developments and fluctuations across key markets.
Despite these challenges, we remain focused on disciplined execution, operational resilience and serving our customers effectively as demand for our core products continue to remain strong.
The demand would have -- would be impacted in all segments if the volatility remains so much and the uncertainty remains so high in the eyes of the buyers.
